user.title: New daily challenge
user.description: Start from scratch, from a template, or group challenges into a leaderboard.

template.title: Choose a template
template.description: The template fills in the next form; you can change everything there.

challenge.title: New daily challenge
challenge.description: Track a daily amount, for example 20 push-ups per day.

data_description.name: Must be unique among your challenges.
data_description.person: Optional. Shows the person's picture and lets reminders go to their phone.
data_description.unit: Pick a suggestion or type your own unit.
data_description.daily_target: Amount you want to reach every day.
data_description.start_date: First day of the challenge. Cannot be in the future.
data_description.end_date: Optional last day of the challenge.
data_description.steps: Up to 3 amounts in ascending order. Each one gets a + button; the smallest one is also used for the − button.
data_description.streak_rule: When a day counts towards your streak.
data_description.deficit_mode: What happens when you fall behind.

rising_target.name: Rising target
rising_target.description: Raise the daily target step by step, e.g. +1 every week.

data_description.target_increase: Amount added to the daily target per interval. 0 switches it off.
data_description.target_max: Optional. The target never grows above this.

source.name: Automatic counting
source.description: Take today's value from another entity, for example a step counter.

data_description.source_entity: Optional. Leave empty to count by hand.
data_description.source_mode: Daily value: the source shows today's amount and sets it; the buttons are not available then. Counter: the source keeps rising and every increase is added.

milestone_settings.name: Milestones
milestone_settings.description: Fire an event when the challenge reaches a milestone.

data_description.milestones: Without a selection there is no milestone event.

group.title: New group
group.description: Rank several challenges against each other, e.g. one per family member. Each challenge keeps its own target.

data_description.name: Must be unique among your challenges and groups.
data_description.members: At least 2 challenges, e.g. one per person.
data_description.ranking: Percent of the own target is fair when the targets differ.

goal_settings.name: Shared goal
goal_settings.description: Collect an amount together, e.g. 500 km as a family per month.

data_description.group_goal: Optional. All challenges need the same unit.
data_description.group_goal_period: The shared goal starts again every week, month or year.

error.name_exists: A challenge with this name already exists.
error.invalid_target: The daily target must be a whole number from 1 to 100000.
error.start_in_future: The start date cannot be in the future.
error.end_before_start: The end date must be after the start date.
error.invalid_steps: Enter 1 to 3 whole numbers from 1 to 100000.
error.steps_not_ascending: Steps must be unique and in ascending order.
error.source_is_challenge: An entity of Daily Challenge cannot be the source.
error.invalid_increase: The increase must be a whole number from 0 to 100000.
error.invalid_target_max: The maximum must be a whole number from the daily target to 100000.
error.invalid_group_goal: The goal must be a whole number above 0.
error.units_differ: A shared goal needs challenges with the same unit.

date_before_start.message: {date} is before the start date of the challenge ({start_date}).

date_after_end.message: {date} is after the end date of the challenge ({end_date}).

invalid_range.message: The start {start} is after the end {end}.

today_from_source.message: Today's value comes from {entity_id} and cannot be changed by hand.

is_group.message: {name} is a group, not a challenge.

add.name: Add amount
add.description: Adds an amount to a day of a challenge. The result never drops below 0.

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: Amount to add. Negative values subtract.

date.name: Date
date.description: Day to update. Defaults to today.

set.name: Set value
set.description: Sets the value of a day of a challenge. 0 removes the entry.

date.name: Date
date.description: Day to update. Defaults to today.

get_history.name: Get history
get_history.description: Returns the daily values, targets and streak fulfilment of a challenge.

start.name: Start
start.description: First day to return. Defaults to the start date of the challenge.

end.name: End
end.description: Last day to return. Defaults to today.

get_status.name: Get status
get_status.description: Returns today's value, target, streaks and the sums of this week, month and year of a challenge, or the ranking of a group.

source.description: The challenge {name} counts automatically from {entity_id}, but it has been unavailable for at least 12 hours. Pick another source or switch automatic counting off. If the source comes back, this message disappears by itself.
